acceptance: The client-page spec passes on the dev stack and in portal-e2e CI, run ids in evidence.
forge new scaffolds a server page and a client page; both serve on first push.
author: rory

gaps.description: src/cmd/new.rs: the scaffold test's doc comment ran one line past the wrap width after the TSX-28 edit; rewrapped.

The starter client page's click sets a cell only and calls no op: hello is a query whose REST route is a GET, and an action POSTs, so an op call on click would need a mutation the starter does not declare. The intent's 'calls an op over REST and renders the result' is carried by forge-portal-e2e's client-page fixture (add_note, the loader re-run listing the row), and the starter's loader still fetches hello over REST in the browser
gaps.note: the acceptance asks the starter only that both modes serve on first push, and adding a write op to every dialect's starter widens forge new beyond this step's intent

gaps.description: ci/e2e.yml.template in forge-portal-e2e did not gain forge_cli_ref
gaps.note: that file is headed OBSOLETE, kept for reference, and never carried portal_web_ref; the live workflow .github/workflows/e2e.yml did

gaps.description: forge-cli was built through the plain cargo shim, not .harness/cargo as the brief said
gaps.note: forge-cli is a hybrid consumer with wrap: false and has no .harness/cargo; the brief's operating fact was wrong, the forge-build skill's command was followed

Diffed forge-cli step-tsx28 (61dbabf..72afb1c: templates/workspace-dialect/apps/web/pages/wave.tsx, components/wave.tsx, README.md, src/cmd/new.rs), forge-portal-web step-tsx28 (046d534..48ee433: components_guide.py client-page section, regenerated components.json and cms seed) and forge-portal-e2e step-tsx28 (0e5109e..0141dbb: client-page.spec.ts, fixtures/client-page-app, customer-two /wave assertions, e2e.yml forge_cli_ref) against intent tsx-components-2026-10-tsx-28-a-client-page-end-to-end: a client page holding a typed cell, handling a click, calling add_note over its REST route with X-Forge-CSRF and rendering the re-run loader's rows is driven in real Chromium on the dev stack (ws-b10412ee85cbe70e) and in portal-e2e CI run 38723053727 (success, 214 passed, at the pushed heads); forge new scaffolds / (server) and /wave (client) sharing Greeting, both served on first push in all four dialects. No evaluator, cell or loader code changed; the align-boundary gaps stand as recorded.

statement: A real interactive client page is proven end to end, and the customer starter offers both modes — Extend forge-portal-e2e with a client page that holds state, handles a click, calls an op over REST and renders the result; extend forge new's TSX starter (TSX-17) with a client page beside the server page. The record is forge-platform-architecture ADR-0039 (decisions 7a, 8, 9), which supersedes ADR-0038 decision 7's 'no JavaScript' paragraph.
